name: Segmented render
purpose: Renders a long film (over 180 s) in checkpointed segments of about 90 s cut at scene edges, resumes an interrupted render at the first unfinished segment, joins them with a stream copy and checks the frame count. Called by studio.py build in place of a single hyperframes render.
capabilities: resumes from renders/<format>/chunks/ while the render fingerprint is unchanged
verifies each segment and the joined track frame count

compatibility.notes: Verified on a 22 s film in 8 s segments on the M2 host (660 frames; PSNR against a single-pass render 43 dB or better, no change at the cuts; kill and resume tested). Not yet run on a 5-12 minute film.

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.

approval_evidence: Segment join and resume exercised on style-sample-chronicle (2026-11-08). Experimental until a 5-12 minute film has been built through it.
